S33/S34/S35/S36 (619-632, 767-791) are four tracer sites belonging to ONE drawn hop: the vertical that runs from the bottom of R16 down to the ground rail bulges right in a semicircle (arc edges e80+e85, verified in the pixel dump at (622,780) - the arc leaves the vertical at y=767 and rejoins it at y=791) around the horizontal wire at y=780. With the hop honoured, n12 = {Q14 collector, Q19 collector, Q20 base} and R16 is a 50k base resistor from Q14's base to ground, which is sensible. The crossing reading would leave the '+5V' label naming only R8's right end while the transistor node it obviously labels went unnamed. S10 (512,370) = JUNCTION for the same reason - the plain X at the +6V tap of the same ladder. S2 (581,156), S3 (332,258), S11 (335,372), S25 (880,494), S26 (143,499), S27 (756,536), S30 (509,639) are plain T-junctions where one wire terminates on another: junction.
